import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, rev;
        long flow, cap;
        long cost;

        Edge(int src, int dst, int rev, long flow, long cap, long cost) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    int n;
    List<List<Edge>> adj;
    long[] potential;
    long oo = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    long[] dist;
    Edge[] back;

    public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        potential = new long[n];
        dist = new long[n];
        back = new Edge[n];
    }

    void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
        adj.get(src).add(new Edge(src, dst, adj.get(dst).size(), 0, cap, cost));
        if (src == dst) {
            adj.get(src).get(adj.get(src).size() - 1).rev++;
        }
        adj.get(dst).add(new Edge(dst, src, adj.get(src).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    long rcost(Edge e) {
        return e.cost + potential[e.src] - potential[e.dst];
    }

    long dijkstra(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, oo);
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
        dist[source] = 0;
        pq.offer(new long[]{0, source});
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            long[] p = pq.poll();
            long d = p[0];
            int u = (int) p[1];
            if (dist[u] < d) continue;
            if (u == sink) break;
            for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.dst] > dist[e.src] + rcost(e)) {
                    back[e.dst] = e;
                    dist[e.dst] = dist[e.src] + rcost(e);
                    pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink];
    }

    long[] maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        long flow = 0;
        long cost = 0;
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
            for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                e.flow = 0;
            }
        }
        Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
        Arrays.fill(back, null);
        while (dijkstra(source, sink) < oo) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                if (dist[u] < dist[sink]) {
                    potential[u] += dist[u] - dist[sink];
                }
            }
            long f = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (Edge e = back[sink]; e != null; e = back[e.src]) {
                f = Math.min(f, e.cap - e.flow);
            }
            for (Edge e = back[sink]; e != null; e = back[e.src]) {
                e.flow += f;
                adj.get(e.dst).get(e.rev).flow -= f;
            }
            flow += f;
            cost += f * (potential[sink] - potential[source]);
        }
        return new long[]{flow, cost};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int totalNodes = (n + 2) * 102;
        MinCostMaxFlow g = new MinCostMaxFlow(totalNodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < 102; i++) {
            g.addEdge((i * (n + 2)) + 1, i * (n + 2), 100, i * c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n + 1; j++) {
                g.addEdge(j + (i * (n + 2)), j + ((i + 1) * (n + 2)), 100, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            g.addEdge(n + 1, u, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < 101; j++) {
                for (int f = 0; f < k; f++) {
                    g.addEdge(u + (j * (n + 2)), v + ((j + 1) * (n + 2)), 1, ((2 * f) + 1) * d);
                    g.addEdge(v + (j * (n + 2)), u + ((j + 1) * (n + 2)), 1, ((2 * f) + 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        long[] result = g.maxFlow(n + 1, (101 * (n + 2)));
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
